transport: Modbus TCP over Ethernet · default TCP port 502 (register 4137 modbus_port_register, R/W, 0–65535) · unit/slave ID default 10 decimal (register 4326 ClassicModbusAddr, R/W, 0–255). ALSO Modbus RTU over RS-232 on an RJ-11 phone jack — "Default RS-232 format is Baud Rate 19.2K, No parity, 8 bits, 1 stop bit (N81)". There is NO RS-485 port on a Classic.

unmappedReports: Absorb time remaining (4139, seconds, counts down to Float) and Equalize time remaining (4143, seconds) — a countdown inside a charge stage has no MetricKind; charge-stage carries the stage but not how long is left in it., Seconds spent in Float today (4138, reset at 23:59) — no MetricKind., Last measured PV open-circuit voltage (4122 VocLastMeasured, 4231 VocRD, 4224 PreVoc, /10 V) — pv-voltage is the loaded terminal voltage; Voc is a different quantity and is the number that tells you a string is disconnected., Daily amp-hours generated (4125) and lifetime amp-hours generated (4128/4129) — consumed-amp-hours is a battery-monitor drawdown figure, not generation. There is no "amp-hours generated" MetricKind., PWM duty cycle command (4141, raw 0–1023, explicitly "NOT Percent") — no MetricKind., Arc-fault and ground-fault status, over-temperature, EEPROM error, HyperVoc, and ~30 other condition bits in InfoFlagsBits (4130/4131) and InfoFlagsBits3 (4104) — the contract has no fault or alarm MetricKind at all, only the clear-fault CommandKind. Everything a Classic knows about why it stopped is currently unrepresentable., Reason-for-resting (4275) and reason-for-reset (4142) enumerations — no MetricKind; these are the difference between "night" and "tripped"., Sliding current limit (4152, A) — the live derated ceiling, distinct from the configured limit at 4148. pv-power-ceiling exists but is a forecast-side concept., WhizBang Jr shunt internal temperature (4372, low byte, °C − 50) — battery-temperature is the 4132 external probe; this is a third temperature., Aux 1 / Aux 2 configured function and Off/Auto/On position (4165) — switch-state covers the position but not which of the 21 Aux 1 functions (diversion, vent fan, night light, GFP trip, …) is programmed., Temperature-compensated battery regulation target (4244, /10 V) — the moving setpoint the controller is actually aiming at; no MetricKind.
